strategic_capability_mapping.why_now: RRP-5.16 left 11 release-blocking headless payload families. These events carry continuation, run-drive, product completion, journey, and completion-finalization evidence used by headless resume/replay, so they must not remain arbitrary versioned-open payloads before Runtime release.
strategic_capability_mapping.evidence: brownie-store validates strict HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded, HeadlessRunSessionAdvanced, HeadlessRunSessionDriveCompleted, HeadlessRunProductEvidenceMatrixDerived, HeadlessRunSelectedProductGapClosureRecorded, HeadlessRunProductCompletionDecisionRecorded, HeadlessJourneyStarted, HeadlessJourneyRouteResumed, HeadlessJourneyClosed, HeadlessJourneyExecuted, and HeadlessRunCompletionFinalized payload fields before append/read, preserves legacy v1 through v12 payload-envelope read compatibility, and the generated semantic contract records closed status for every LedgerEventKind with release_blocking_open_payload_count 0.
strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Closes the protocol-event-canonization release blocker by assigning every LedgerEventKind a closed strict_typed or payload_absent contract, leaving runtime-release-guard-ci as the remaining Runtime-owned release blocker.

answers.strategic_capabilities: RRP-5.17 closes protocol-event-canonization by moving the remaining headless continuation, headless run, journey, and completion-finalization ledger event families to strict typed payload validation.
answers.new_capability: New headless ledger payload appends reject unknown fields, malformed field types, missing bounded continuation/run/journey evidence, and unbounded raw prompt/provider/file evidence before durable append/read.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: RRP-5.16 made workspace patch events strict typed, but 11 headless payload families still accepted arbitrary versioned-open payloads despite carrying resume, replay, product completion, and journey-finalization evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still record malformed headless continuation or run/journey completion evidence while claiming protocol-event-canonization progress.
answers.non_duplicative: This is the final RRP-5.17 headless event-family slice; it does not repeat RRP-5.5 inventory, RRP-5.6 through RRP-5.16 prior payload-family typing, RRP-7.2 durability/deadline work, or CI workflow hardening.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. RRP-5.17 adds no JSON-RPC method and only hardens durable ledger payload validation plus generated contract evidence.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The generated semantic contract and audit files are guard evidence, not a new user-facing Runtime summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Ledger appends with payloads for the remaining headless continuation/run/journey/completion-finalization families now use strict schemas, reject additional fields, and validate required bounded headless evidence before writing or reading.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless resume/replay gains stronger evidence because continuation decisions, run-session advances, product completion decisions, journey transitions, and completion finalization can no longer be arbitrary versioned-open payloads on new writes.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes protocol-event-canonization by reducing release_blocking_open_payload_count from 11 to 0 while keeping Runtime Release Ready false until runtime-release-guard-ci and owner license/publish/release decisions are resolved.

runtime_boundary_contracts: No new RPC surface is added; existing Runtime JSON-RPC and ledger semantics are preserved and more strictly checked.
CLI and VSIX remain thin clients over Runtime-owned contracts.
external_control_plane_responsibilities: External scheduling, queueing, worker leases, hosted isolation, retry policy, metrics, alerts, SLA, tenant administration, billing, and secret-provider operations remain outside this local Runtime v0 phase.
external_adapter_responsibilities: Forge, pull request, review, notification, SIEM, OTel, language verifier, customer integration, and hosted MCP adapter responsibilities remain outside RRP-5.17.
commercial_solution_readiness: Packaging, distribution, signing, notarization, enterprise administration, operational runbooks, support, and commercial release decisions remain out of scope.
Cargo license and publish settings remain owner-decision items and are not changed by RRP-5.17.
